claim_boundary: Internal fixture-backed validation for implemented+usable+validated maturity only; commercial-grade still requires external corpora, independent review, and trusted-tool diffs.

validated_items.title: SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM account and permission deep parser
assertions: windows-account-lifecycle rows preserve user name, RID, UAC flags, SAM F/V candidate fields, group membership hints, inherited privilege context, source hashes, and #6 core_accuracy_gates.
windows-lsa-policy-location rows preserve secret metadata without decrypting or exposing protected values.
windows-privilege-assignment rows attribute high-risk privileges to assigned SID/principal hints.
build_os_account_trusted_diff compares account/group/privilege rows with trusted SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM parser output by user/RID/SID, UAC flags, group names, privileges, and secret redaction state.
account reportability decisions keep rows as triage pivots until SAM F/V, alias-member, SECURITY, domain, and transaction-log validation is attached.
blockers_kept: full native SAM F/V layout validation

validated_items.title: Amcache parser
assertions: amcache-entry rows preserve path, program name, publisher, SHA1, timestamp source, execution caveat, source hash, and #7 core_accuracy_gates.
amcache-hive native rows preserve bounded path/hash string pivots and keep native schema decode blockers explicit.
build_execution_artifact_trusted_diff can compare Amcache rows with AmcacheParser/RECmd-style output by executable path, timestamp, SHA1, and semantics warning.
Amcache reportability decisions block standalone execution claims.

validated_items.title: ShimCache/AppCompatCache parser
assertions: shimcache-entry rows preserve path/timestamp candidates, source order, OS-layout warning, not-proof-of-execution wording, #8 core_accuracy_gates, and program-presence-only reportability decisions.
build_execution_artifact_trusted_diff can compare ShimCache rows with AppCompatCacheParser/ShimCacheParser-style output while preserving the not-proof-of-execution warning.
blockers_kept: native AppCompatCache binary layout decoding across Windows versions

validated_items.title: BAM/DAM execution parser
assertions: bam-entry rows preserve SID, device path, FILETIME timestamp, CurrentControlSet attribution, execution semantics warning, #9 core_accuracy_gates, and correlate-before-testimony reportability decisions.
build_execution_artifact_trusted_diff can compare BAM/DAM rows with trusted SYSTEM hive/BAM parser output by path, SID, timestamp, and semantics warning.
blockers_kept: native SYSTEM hive BAM/DAM binary value interpretation

validated_items.title: SRUM full ESE table parser
assertions: srum-network-usage rows preserve source-tool app/user/timestamp/counter normalization.

srum-database-file, srum-table-candidate, and srum-row-candidate rows preserve ESE header validation, table markers, row string candidates, counter/timestamp candidates, source hashes, #10 core_accuracy_gates, and native-row-not-decoded reportability decisions.
build_execution_artifact_trusted_diff can compare SRUM rows with SrumECmd/libesedb-style output by app/path, timestamp, user SID, and counter hash.
blockers_kept: page checksum validation beyond fixture header/page-size checks
